title: The Deer With Vampire Fangs Instead of Antlers

scenes.text: This deer has fangs instead of antlers.
Male Chinese water deer grow tusks several inches long.
They use them to fight rival males in the breeding season.
In thick undergrowth, antlers tangle. Fangs don't.
They live in wetlands, and they swim well.
A vampire that only eats plants.

description:
This deer has fangs instead of antlers.
Male Chinese water deer have long downward-pointing tusks and no antlers, and they use the tusks to fight each other in the breeding season.
Would you want to meet one in the wild? Comment below.
first_comment: Fangs or antlers: which would you rather have?
